d: Nearly 20 Iranian vessels are stranded in international waters near Sri Lanka amid the US naval blockade of Iranian ports. With some ships reportedly running short of food, water and fuel, 40 Iranian sailors have needed urgent medical treatment. Sri Lankan authorities have stepped in to help, but Colombo faces a delicate balancing act. It wants to save lives without being drawn into the US-Iran conflict. The crisis comes months after an Iranian warship sank off Sri Lanka following a US submarine attack, killing more than 80 crew members. With more Iranian vessels still stranded at sea, how…
